name: p06-model2-source-default-qualification

episode.grid_persistence: between actions within one episode; fresh at next episode
episode.synchronization: complete controller decision, then one source plant step

logical_rng_assignment.algorithm: NumPy RandomState MT19937, current pinned NumPy 2.3.5
logical_rng_assignment.plant_schedule_mask_stream: one RandomState(seed) per episode, reset draws first
per_action_order: one rng.randint(50,60) for recurrent epoch count
mask true iff sample <= 0.5; C-order epoch,row,column assignment
logical_rng_assignment.physical_stall_dependence: none; draws attach to logical action, epoch and cell

result_policy.success: terminal at 10001 actions with cart and pole still within source limits
result_policy.score: sum of source runtime cosine reward including terminal transition
result_policy.incomplete: checkpointed interruption is neither a pass nor a failed ten-seed result

rights: local-only ignored model2 blob; no weight tensors/images committed or shared
